snippet.title: 99Rooms slow walk-through - 2004
snippet.description:
Attention : Checkout our Bandcamp for the 99Rooms Soundtrack! https://rostlaub.bandcamp.com

99Rooms is an unique internet art project that mixes wall painting, photography, animation and sound. Shortly after its launch in June 2004, more than 10 million individuals throughout the world have already visited this interdisciplinary composite work of art. 99Rooms stemmed from the mystical, often apocalyptically charming pictures created by Berlin artist Kim Köster within the countless vacated premises of East Berlin‘s industrial sector.

Footage of http://99rooms.com
